rows.title: sync: merge verified floww main into floww-2
rows.body:
Merges mrbeast1179-sketch/floww@a9a54b2 (416 commits) into odaialdajani/floww-2@1a512c3 (23 commits), preserving both histories.

Ancestor: eb394d8
Merge commit: 1b7ddf6 (local, pushed as sync/floww-into-floww2)

Preserved:
- Destination Lodestar W1+W2 layer (backend/services/agent/*)
- 3.11 runtime, fastapi 0.136.3 ceiling, honest-verify gates
- Unions: Public API bars/history/technical/expirations, server rate-limits, AppShell

Excluded (still open in source, not merged):
- PR69 fix/skylit-panel-bugs
- PR71 agent2/fetched-at-pipeline-v2
- PR72 a3/xh1-proxy-labels

Gates on merge tree:
- ruff: PASS (after import sort fix)
- quant 3.11 syntax: PASS
- silent-excepts parser tests: 27 passed
- vpin+silent: 37 passed
- silent-except gate: RED (pre-existing: 6 on dest main, 16 on merge — 10 new from source, needs justification pass)
- Full backend suite / frontend build: not run locally (needs mongo / npm ci); CI will report.

Use merge commit, not squash.

docs(round6): research-paper-grade brief for Qwen prompt generation

Single source of truth for Round 6 — written for an LLM (Qwen) to
mechanically expand each of 10 agent charters into a complete coding-
agent prompt without needing to invent context or guess at constraints.

Document structure:
  §1  System state — what exists today, with file paths + status
  §2  Operating invariants (I-1..I-10) — RFC-2119 normative, non-relaxable
  §3  Round 5 post-mortem — root causes + encoded preventatives
  §4  Round 6 mission — (D)/(V)/(H) task classification + critical path
  §5  Architecture reference — repo layout, conventions, public interfaces
  §6  Agent charter — per-agent: mission, ownership, deps, acceptance
       §6.1 File ownership matrix (the antidote to Round 5 chaos)
       §6.2 Dependency DAG
  §7  Standing operating protocol — preamble every prompt MUST include
  §8  Verification standard — 5-item checklist per task
  §9  Failure handling — three-strike rule, wrong-clone detection
  §10 Qwen generation instructions — exact output format expected
  §11 Quick-reference card

Also adds docs/ROUND6_COMPLETION_LOG.md as the agreed-upon log surface.

The file ownership matrix in §6.1 structurally prevents the Round 5
failure mode where four agents independently overwrote cache_router.py.
Each file now has exactly one PRIMARY OWNER for Round 6; cross-agent
changes go through PR to the owner.

fix(skylit): end the recurring panel errors — never-422 backend + FE contract fixes

Root cause of the repeating Skylit-tab errors: frontend<->backend contract drift
across multiple panels (never audited as a class) + a stale build that hid prior
source fixes.

Backend — kills the HTTP 422 class permanently: flip-zones/air-pockets drop the
hard ge/le Query bounds and instead normalize+clamp via _norm_frac (a percent
like window_pct=5 or min_gap_pct=1 becomes a fraction; out-of-range clamps).
Never 422 again, whatever any panel sends.

Frontend contract fixes (found by a full 12-panel audit):
- NodeLifecycle Tap%: was *100 on an already-percent value -> 8000%; now raw.
- FlipZones: compared string from_sign/to_sign ("positive"/"negative") with > 0
  -> always "- -> -" and bearish; now === "positive".
- AirPockets: minGapPct default 1 -> 0.02; span_pct now *100 (was ~0.01%).
- BeachBall: direction checked "up"/"down" but backend returns "above"/"below";
  spot_distance_pct now *100.
- SwarmFrame: HEAD-probes the URL before mounting the iframe -> calm placeholder
  instead of the browser ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED flash.

docs(round6): research-paper-grade brief for Qwen prompt generation

Single source of truth for Round 6 — written for an LLM (Qwen) to
mechanically expand each of 10 agent charters into a complete coding-
agent prompt without needing to invent context or guess at constraints.

Document structure:
  §1  System state — what exists today, with file paths + status
  §2  Operating invariants (I-1..I-10) — RFC-2119 normative, non-relaxable
  §3  Round 5 post-mortem — root causes + encoded preventatives
  §4  Round 6 mission — (D)/(V)/(H) task classification + critical path
  §5  Architecture reference — repo layout, conventions, public interfaces
  §6  Agent charter — per-agent: mission, ownership, deps, acceptance
       §6.1 File ownership matrix (the antidote to Round 5 chaos)
       §6.2 Dependency DAG
  §7  Standing operating protocol — preamble every prompt MUST include
  §8  Verification standard — 5-item checklist per task
  §9  Failure handling — three-strike rule, wrong-clone detection
  §10 Qwen generation instructions — exact output format expected
  §11 Quick-reference card

Also adds docs/ROUND6_COMPLETION_LOG.md as the agreed-upon log surface.

The file ownership matrix in §6.1 structurally prevents the Round 5
failure mode where four agents independently overwrote cache_router.py.
Each file now has exactly one PRIMARY OWNER for Round 6; cross-agent
changes go through PR to the owner.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

- NaN guards on all counts (I-8 compliance)
- Returns zeros + error on exception (no 500)
- Write 7 tests in backend/tests/routes/test_alerts_summary.py

  - total = critical + warning + info invariant

fix(skylit): end the recurring panel errors — never-422 backend + FE contract fixes

Root cause of the repeating Skylit-tab errors: frontend<->backend contract drift
across multiple panels (never audited as a class) + a stale build that hid prior
source fixes.

Backend — kills the HTTP 422 class permanently: flip-zones/air-pockets drop the
hard ge/le Query bounds and instead normalize+clamp via _norm_frac (a percent
like window_pct=5 or min_gap_pct=1 becomes a fraction; out-of-range clamps).
Never 422 again, whatever any panel sends.

Frontend contract fixes (found by a full 12-panel audit):
- NodeLifecycle Tap%: was *100 on an already-percent value -> 8000%; now raw.
- FlipZones: compared string from_sign/to_sign ("positive"/"negative") with > 0
  -> always "- -> -" and bearish; now === "positive".
- AirPockets: minGapPct default 1 -> 0.02; span_pct now *100 (was ~0.01%).
- BeachBall: direction checked "up"/"down" but backend returns "above"/"below";
  spot_distance_pct now *100.
- SwarmFrame: HEAD-probes the URL before mounting the iframe -> calm placeholder
  instead of the browser ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED flash.

Verification:
$ curl '.../flip-zones?ticker=SPY&window_pct=5'  -> 200 (was 422)
$ curl '.../air-pockets?ticker=SPY&min_gap_pct=1' -> 200 (was 422)

$ dev server (craco start)                        -> Compiled successfully

## Solstice sweep-9 — net-new follow-through (read-only, additive)

Follow-up to #13–#17 (all merged). Verified no overlap with #17 (deduplicated
byte-identical convergent work; kept only net-new changes).

### Changes
- **T07:** `interactions` + `scenarios` attached to the heatmap payload (same
  snapshot for UI inspector and AI evidence); inspector renders
  state/event/touches with unknown-first semantics.
- **T09:** `DUCKDB_PATH` file backing for the shared engine with crash-safe
  memory fallback (research history can now survive restarts).
- **T24:** scheduler config test (cap/floor behavior).
- **T29:** `RECONCILIATION.md` (merged PRs vs master-plan status table) and
  `FROZEN_PROTOCOL.md` (frozen hypotheses/baselines/params/outcomes/costs;
  collection inventory: 2 snapshots, 0 outcome events — collection phase).

### Verification
- Solstice + envelope: 70 passed; ruff + silent gate clean; frontend 24/97.
- Rollback: additive only.

rows.title: R4 P01+P02: audit reconciliation, immutable snapshots, typed quality, strict evidence
rows.body:
## Revision-4 P01 (reconcile) + P02 (snapshot and quality)

Implements the R4 audit's first repair packages against `main@5f325e10`.
No merges performed by this PR; no live calls; execution stays disarmed.

### P01
`RECONCILIATION.md` gains per-finding verdicts: R4-01–R4-04 repaired here
with red-first evidence; R4-05–R4-18 confirmed by inspection/code and mapped
to P03–P12 targets.

### P02
- **Snapshot identity (R4-01):** ID binds canonical content digest
  (normalized strikes/cells, scope, metric/formula versions, provenance) plus
  observation time; payload deep-copied at build; recorder digest delegates.
- **Quality (R4-02):** one typed adapter, unknown-first (missing → unavailable/
  ineligible), reason codes preserved, source/receipt/compute clocks separate.
- **Evidence (R4-03):** `/evidence` serves recorded-ID replay or full-scope
  rebuild with identical query keys; packets carry wall/scope/formula facts.
- **Validator (R4-04):** complete schema, citation per observation, typed
  number↔fact binding, untrusted-text quarantine, failure≠pass, real
  injections delivered to the packet.

### Verification
- Red-first: 7/8 new tests failed on baseline, 8/8 pass after.
- `backend/tests/solstice/`: 68 passed. Ruff + silent-except gate clean.
- Rollback: additive; legacy payload shape unchanged.

rows.body:
